author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
This thread will be about suggestions for donator ranks that you would think would be cool.


My Suggestions

/nv or /nightvision

This gives you permanent night vision WHILE as a spectator; Can't be used when playing a game.

/bloodtrail

This gives you perms to toggle trails that you buy in the lobby that you want to see when you hit a player (replacement for blood)

Community Suggestions:



Post what you want here vvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvvv

replies.author: vladthegreat100
replies.body:
Nightvision is useless. Especially in spectator mode. What you gonna do, spectate every game? If your a donor your probably not going to do that since there usually is no wait period to join a game.

Why blood trail? Just a bunch of particles that will cause lag to the average client. Sure you will probably be able to toggle it but why have it as a perk if it will be toggled.

What Avicus needs is permanent ranks and perks that actually help in game. No one follows EULA and was probably never enforced. Don't want it pay to win? We had a much better player count as a pay to win server. No one wants to pay for a teamspeak rank that gives the same perks, credit boosters are pretty rad, and why give a chance to join full games if it isn't even possible to join games with both teams full? With the player count we have you are probably leaving out a few players that isn't enough to actually start a new game, and if you can why the hell play it? There is so little people that it no longer will be fun.

One thing I find annoying of this "realistic" blood effect, is that it's red stone particles so you can only change the color of it, if you'd be willing to sacrifice the color of your red stone block. I'd much rather have a particle effect from the actual particles.png file in your Resource Pack to edit and have that as my "blood".

I think that would give resource pack makers in Avicus have another layer in making them because this would help for PvPers, and it's just fun to edit.
